mechanism.claim: joint implied-volatility expansion, rising OI and a large funding-confirmed completed-hour BTC chase identify crowded directional inventory vulnerable to a twelve-hour reversal
mechanism.side: negative sign of the completed-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct_from_ocdr: OICER requires a large signed BTC chase and only uses funding for sign concurrence; it has no extreme-funding tail
mechanism.why_distinct_from_ovepr: OICER never uses premium-index direction or efficiency and requires OI build plus completed-hour price exhaustion

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility: positive normalized BVOL and DVOL bodies with DVOL body strictly larger
clock.oi: raw-time backward-asof observations at T and T-60m, each age<=5m; positive change >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.price: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T); return=last close/first open-1; abs return >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.funding: latest nonzero event at or before T; sign must equal completed-hour return sign
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_hour_price: materialize exact Postgres bars_binance 1m hourly OHLC/count after commit; source support may open only [T-1h,T) feature bars
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
